title:
Transform that expects a {@link FetchResultWithTotalCount<FeatureFetchBase>} and adds new fields
to each feature for the Model Scenario grid, given the {@link ModelScenarioApplicationState#overriddenFeatures}.

It adds the following fields:
- `edited`: a string indicating that the feature is edited.
- `simulationModel`: the type of the overridden feature.
- `newValue`: a string representation of the new value for the feature, based on the type of the overridden feature.
name: ModelScenarioFeatureDataGridTransform
